summary: King County, WA lookout tower below Humphrey Mountain's summit, built 1934 or 1935 and burned in 1973; a 2015 visit found only weather-station posts and footings.

facts.status_note: Burned in 1973; a 2015 visit found weather-station posts and footings, not the tower

access.note: Willhite lists road access as restricted; no source describes public visits

events.note: Register and firelookout.com give 1935; Willhite says probably early 1934
Panoramic photos taken from the lookout on August 8, 1934
Aircraft Warning Service cabin built on the summit; Forest Lookouts lists Seattle Filter Center activation September 3, 1942 and deactivation October 16, 1943
Met a fiery end in 1973; Forest Lookouts records removal by burning; Willhite says burned to the ground
Registered May 26, 2012; nominated by Ray Kresek
Visit found all four weather-station posts, one still standing, plus footings and foundation blocks

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'unknown' replaced by restricted, from Willhite's 'Road Access: Restricted' label. No lookout watch or named staff in any source read, so no staffing key. Build year conflict (1934 vs 1935) shown in the story. 20 ft converted to 6.1 m. No photos recorded; FFLOS credits National Archives panoramas but no image URLs were read.
